'''Sovran''' was an individual who had a number of disciples and students who adhered to Sovran's teachings and wielded [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Sovran also used a lightsaber, and was the namesake of several styles of lightsaber.
